Subject: Evening CIO briefing — compact handback and standby CTO

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking time to talk yesterday. We heard that your CIO's calendar is tight during daytime hours next week — they asked whether we could run a compact, focused briefing in the evening window and keep the slot to ~45 minutes.

Proposed plan:
- 45-minute compact briefing (product highlights + targeted cost/latency Q&A)
- 10-min optional technical deep dive for the CTO afterwards (Marcus to lead)
- If the CIO needs to step out early, we’ll have the CTO join as a standby to finish procurement/architecture items.

Candidate windows (PT):
- Tue 2025-10-14, 18:00–18:45 PT
- Wed 2025-10-15, 18:30–19:15 PT (preferred by our team)

Attached: mutual action plan and the draft agenda for the compact briefing. Can you confirm whether 18:30 PT on Wed works for the CIO? If yes, we'll send a calendar invite and a brief checklist for procurement (SOC2 certs, SSO options).

Also copying Soojin and Marcus to coordinate the technical run and any late schedules.

Best,
Naomi Feldman

Naomi — thanks for the clear options. The CIO's calendar is slotted tight, but they can do Wed 18:30 PT for a condensed 45-minute session. They'd like the CTO to be on standby in case they need to step out at ~18:55.

We also request that the calendar invite be sent to procurement@solastis.com and include the M.A.P. as a link or attachment.

I'll take 18:30 PT on Wed and will forward to procurement for a formal hold.
